utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the twentieth. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: We can hear you. Sadly, nothing from the broken coffee machine in the canteen. Absolutely dead.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Probably heard what we call its coffee and taken offence.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And the heating in the portakabin is on. In August. Lovely combination, no coffee and gently roasting.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's your luxury office package, that is.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, neither of those is going on this engineering list. Before the live jobs, a few things that are already closed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I signed off the inspection on the boiler safety valve on Tuesday. That's done, not something we're allocating again.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Same here, signed off the inspection on the old turbine on Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: But for any further access, I can't get to the old turbine until production gives us a window. That's still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Completed inspection stays completed; further access is blocked, no new job agreed there.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the power pack on one yesterday. Just so that doesn't get dragged forward.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, different filter from the one we're about to discuss.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly. The power pack on one is done.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Only other thing from nights: noticed the big valve by the gate was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Settled back down, yeah? You're flagging an observation, not asking for work on it?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, just an observation. Nothing being added off the back of that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And the shutdown on the turbine two is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, cancelled. Keep that out of the actions. Let's do the actual priorities.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Haley, can you swap the filter on the CT1 tomorrow at 9:30? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll swap the filter on the CT1 tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's the production hold-up, yes. Not the power pack filter Jamie's already done.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Got you. CT1 gets done first, that's my priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Then we've got the vibration readings on the front end of one. Who's able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I'll take vibration readings on the front end of one by 11am. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Just the readings, then, not pulling anything apart?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, just taking the vibration readings. That's what I'm putting my hand up for.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Mide. By 11am, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Dave, can you book a contractor to look at the turbine one compressor by Thursday? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, um, booking made by Thursday, rather than having the contractor physically here by Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly, book them by Thursday, which is today. We're not setting their visit date here. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Understood. I'll book a contractor to look at the turbine one compressor by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Good distinction. A booking and someone actually turning up with a van are very different things.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Especially once you've enjoyed twenty minutes of their hold music.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Mide, can you chase the purchase order for the water booster after lunch?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll chase the purchase order for the water booster after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Water booster, yeah. That's separate from the filter I've just mentioned. Easy to muddle them when everyone's talking at once.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Olumide, can you inspect the feed pump for leaks? That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, I'll inspect the feed pump for leaks. Fairly important, understood.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, spoke over you there. That one's a leak inspection, separate from the vibration readings?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's right. The feed pump for leaks; the front end of one for vibration readings. Two separate jobs.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Mide, can I give you the shift handover report as well—send the shift handover report round by end of day?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that as well. With the readings, the feed pump and the purchase order chase, I'd be stretching it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Safety—sorry, safety Grace, can you take that instead and send the shift handover report round by end of day?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take it instead of Mide. I'll send the shift handover report round by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. And safety Grace, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team for tomorrow? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team for tomorrow. Normal priority, that's fine.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Toolbox talk without canteen coffee. You'll have a very quiet audience.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Quiet would be a first. But yes, organising that one's with me.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: There's the big board as well. Mide, can you run a function test on the big board first thing tomorrow? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, sorry, I can't take that one on as well. Need to leave that with someone else.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Okay. David Whitfield, could you take it instead? Run a function test on the big board first thing tomorrow, low priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take that instead. I'll run a function test on the big board first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And we're keeping that low priority. The timing's agreed, but we're not calling it a production emergency.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, low priority. Understood.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Whereas the CT1 filter is the one holding production up. Just keeping those two straight.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Haley's CT1 filter tomorrow at 9:30 needs doing first. Different urgency from the big board.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just checking mine haven't blurred together: shift handover report round by end of day, toolbox talk for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, safety Grace. And the toolbox talk is normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And no repeat of the power pack filter. Sorry, banging on about it, but I don't fancy seeing yesterday's finished job come back round.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No repeat. That one's closed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Unlike the coffee machine discussion, which will apparently run forever.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Low output, high vibration. Sounds familiar.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's just Callum before breakfast.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers. Knew there was a reason I joined these calls.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a condition report on Callum—everyone clear on what they've accepted?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, clear here.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, all clear.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Same here.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. That's the agreed list, nothing added for the blocked or cancelled work. Thanks, everyone.
